findings.fix: Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: The sheet dealt Switzer and Switzer, but the page renders Inter, Outfit.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: The margins differ: 152px on the left, 174px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Why Choose the Kineticlinks Speed Test Platform" → 3 lines (7 words, 28.3px); "How fast is your service on China’s three networ" → 3 lines (9 words, 28.3px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.
